RemediationStrings.Title: Windows update status could not be checked ({ActualValue})
RemediationStrings.Description: Your device's update level could not be confirmed. Make sure you are connected to the internet, then sync your device in Company Portal. If this message remains, contact the helpdesk.

RemediationStrings.Title: Windows security updates are {ActualValue} days overdue
RemediationStrings.Description: Your device is missing Windows security updates. Open Settings > Windows Update, select Check for updates, install everything offered and restart your device.
